title: Results of the ninth population census (housing and occupation data included) in the Kingdom of the Netherlands, December 1909
descriptions: The dataset is based on three separate censuses of the Netherlands of 1909, population census (5 vols), occupational census (3 vols) and housing census (1 vol). Content: images of the publication, pdf files of the text sections and excel files with data entered from the published tables.
